basic_info.description: Stop paying your landlord's mortgage--start investing in your own future. Step into this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath TIC set within a classic 3-unit Victorian. Freshly painted with new flooring, the home blends timeless character with modern comfort. The spacious living room opens to a tiled front porchperfect for morning coffee or relaxing after workwhile oversized windows fill both bedrooms with natural light. Enjoy the privacy of your own gated entrance, dedicated laundry, and two garage storage spaces for all your extras. With a Walk Score of 99 and Transit Score of 99, you'll love being just steps from Hayes Valley's trendy cafes, restaurants, parks, and shops, plus easy access to Muni, freeways, Safeway, and Whole Foods. This is a rare opportunity to own a charming home in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods. Don't miss it! Some photos include virtual staging.
